name: net.borbur/salary-calculators
title: borbur.net salary and tax calculators
description: Free 2026 take-home pay: Spain, UK, US, Canada, Dubai; Beckham Law, UAE gratuity, D'Hondt.

tools.name: spain_net_salary
tools.description: Net (take-home) pay in Spain in 2026 from a gross annual salary, using the official AEAT withholding algorithm and 2026 Social Security rates. Single employee, no children, under 65, permanent contract. Returns Social Security, withholding rate, withholding and net per year and per month (12 or 14 payments). Source: https://borbur.net/tools/spain-net-salary-calculator/

tools.name: spain_beckham_law
tools.description: Compares take-home pay in Spain in 2026 under the Beckham Law special regime for people moving to Spain (24% flat up to EUR 600,000, 47% above) and under the normal income tax regime, for a gross annual employment salary. Source: https://borbur.net/tools/beckham-law-calculator/

tools.name: us_net_salary
tools.description: US take-home pay in 2026 for a single filer with the standard deduction: federal income tax plus Social Security (6.2% up to $184,500) and Medicare (1.45%, +0.9% above $200,000). No state income tax. Source: https://borbur.net/tools/us-salary-in-spain/

gross.description: Gross annual salary in US dollars

tools.name: dubai_salary_in_spain
tools.description: For a monthly salary in Dubai (no income tax), the gross annual salary needed in Spain in 2026 to take home the same amount. Source: https://borbur.net/tools/dubai-salary-in-spain/

aed_month.description: Monthly salary in Dubai in UAE dirhams (AED)

tools.name: spanish_salary_in_dubai
tools.description: For a gross annual salary in Spain, the monthly Dubai salary (AED) that leaves the same take-home pay, and how much more is kept if the same gross is paid in Dubai. Source: https://borbur.net/tools/spanish-salary-in-dubai/

gross.description: Gross annual salary in Spain in euros

tools.name: us_salary_in_spain
tools.description: For a US gross annual salary, the gross salary needed in Spain in 2026 to take home the same (US federal tax + FICA, no state tax; Spain single, no children). Source: https://borbur.net/tools/us-salary-in-spain/

usd.description: US gross annual salary in dollars

tools.name: spanish_salary_in_the_us
tools.description: For a gross annual salary in Spain, the US salary that leaves the same take-home pay in a state with no income tax. Source: https://borbur.net/tools/spanish-salary-in-the-us/

gross.description: Gross annual salary in Spain in euros

tools.name: uk_net_salary
tools.description: UK take-home pay in 2026/27 (England, Wales, Northern Ireland): income tax (personal allowance £12,570, tapered above £100,000; 20%, 40%, 45%) and employee National Insurance (8% to £50,270, 2% above). Source: https://borbur.net/tools/uk-salary-in-spain/

gross.description: Gross annual salary in pounds sterling

tools.name: uk_salary_in_spain
tools.description: For a UK gross annual salary, the gross salary needed in Spain in 2026 to take home the same (UK 2026/27 income tax + NI; Spain single, no children). Source: https://borbur.net/tools/uk-salary-in-spain/

gbp.description: UK gross annual salary in pounds

tools.name: spanish_salary_in_the_uk
tools.description: For a Spanish gross annual salary in euros, the UK salary that leaves the same take-home pay (Spain 2026; UK 2026/27 income tax + NI, England, Wales, Northern Ireland). Source: https://borbur.net/tools/spanish-salary-in-the-uk/

gross.description: Gross annual salary in Spain in euros

tools.name: canada_net_salary
tools.description: Canadian take-home pay in 2026 in Ontario for a single employee: federal and Ontario income tax (with the Ontario surtax and Health Premium), CPP, CPP2 and Employment Insurance. Source: https://borbur.net/tools/canada-salary-in-dubai/

gross.description: Gross annual salary in Canadian dollars

tools.name: canada_salary_in_dubai
tools.description: For a Canadian (Ontario) gross annual salary, the Dubai salary in AED that leaves the same take-home pay (no income tax in the UAE). Ontario 2026 rules, single employee. Source: https://borbur.net/tools/canada-salary-in-dubai/

cad.description: Canadian gross annual salary in Canadian dollars

tools.name: dubai_salary_in_canada
tools.description: For a monthly Dubai salary in AED (tax-free), the gross annual salary needed in Ontario, Canada, in 2026 to take home the same. Source: https://borbur.net/tools/dubai-salary-in-canada/

aed_month.description: Monthly salary in Dubai in UAE dirhams (AED)

tools.name: uae_gratuity
tools.description: UAE private-sector end-of-service gratuity under Federal Decree-Law 33 of 2021: 21 days of basic salary per year for the first 5 years, 30 days per year after, capped at 2 years of basic salary. Give years of service or days of service. Source: https://borbur.net/tools/uae-gratuity-calculator/

basic.description: Last basic monthly salary in AED

tools.name: dhondt_seats
tools.description: Shares out seats with the D'Hondt method as in Spain's general elections (3% threshold over valid votes, blank votes count as valid). Give a Spanish province (its 2026 Congress seats are used) or a number of seats, and the votes per party. Source: https://borbur.net/tools/dhondt-calculator/

seats.description: Seats to share out (if no province)

tools.name: digital_money_glossary
tools.description: Looks up plain-language definitions of 60 digital-money terms for HR, finance and compliance teams (stablecoin, e-money token, payment token, multi-issuance, redemption, MiCA, GENIUS Act, Wage Protection System, Pay Transparency Directive, token grant, vesting and more), each with why it matters for HR and a link to the guide. Give a term or a word to search; leave it empty to list all terms. English or Spanish. Source: https://borbur.net/topics/digital-money-glossary/

term.description: Term or word to look up, e.g. multi-issuance (optional)

tools.name: digital_money_readiness_check
tools.description: Scores a company's HR readiness for stablecoins, pay transparency and AI rules on 10 questions (jobs, pay, payroll, pay transparency, AI accountability, pipeline, risk talent, structure, evaluation, skills). Give answers as 10 digits in question order: 2 = yes, 1 = partly, 0 = no (e.g. 2121011012). Returns the score out of 20, the band (0-7 Exposed, 8-14 Building, 15-20 Ready) and an action list with the No answers first. Call with no answers to get the questions. Source: https://borbur.net/tools/digital-money-readiness-check/

answers.description: 10 digits, each 0, 1 or 2, in question order (optional)

tools.name: ai_agent_accountability_check
tools.description: Checks whether a company can say who answers for each AI agent it runs, on 10 questions (list of agents, named owner, written limits, sign-off above limits, log, off-switch, notice to staff and candidates, human review, cost, training), based on the Air Canada chatbot ruling, UAE data protection law, DIFC Regulation 10, the UAE AI Charter and the EU AI Act. Give answers as 10 digits in question order: 2 = yes, 1 = partly, 0 = no (e.g. 1210010110). Returns the score out of 20, the band (0-7 Exposed, 8-14 Building, 15-20 In control) and an action list with the No answers first. Call with no answers to get the questions. English, Spanish or Arabic. Source: https://borbur.net/tools/ai-agent-accountability-check/

answers.description: 10 digits, each 0, 1 or 2, in question order (optional)

tools.name: salary_tax_comparator
tools.description: Compares take-home pay, income tax, employee social security, employer cost and the total tax wedge for the same gross salary in 20 countries under 2026 rules (single employee, no children, standard deductions): Spain, Portugal, France (Paris), Germany, Italy (Milan), Netherlands, Belgium, Ireland, United Kingdom (England), Switzerland (Zurich), Sweden, Poland, United States (federal only), Canada (Ontario), Mexico (Mexico City), UAE, Singapore, Japan (Tokyo), Russia and China (Shanghai). Give the gross annual salary and its currency (EUR, USD, GBP, AED, CHF, CAD, SGD, JPY, CNY, MXN, SEK, PLN or RUB); it is converted at ECB reference rates of 20 Nov 2026. Set expat=true for a foreign professional (no CPF in Singapore, no UAE pension). Optionally limit to one country code. Source: https://borbur.net/tools/salary-tax-comparator/

country.description: Optional country code: es, pt, fr, de, it, nl, be, ie, uk, ch, se, pl, us, ca, mx, ae, sg, jp, ru, cn

tools.name: spain_minimum_wage_2027
tools.description: Spain's minimum wage (SMI) from 1 January 2027 under Real Decreto 1013/2026: EUR 1,286 a month in 14 payments, EUR 18,004 a year, EUR 42.87 a day; net after 6.52% employee Social Security; no income tax thanks to the EUR 1,033.58 deduction of Real Decreto-ley 38/2026 (phased out at EUR 23,171.89). Source: https://borbur.net/topics/spain-minimum-wage-2027/
